CVE-2026-136126.title: c-icap-server through 0.5.15 and 0.6.5 contains an out-of-bounds  ...
CVE-2026-136126.description: c-icap-server through 0.5.15 and 0.6.5 contains an out-of-bounds write in process_encapsulated() that allows unauthenticated attackers to corrupt heap memory by sending six Encapsulated entities. Attackers can send a single ICAP request whose sixth entity overwrites trash_entities[0], triggering use-after-free and double free in ci_request_destroy() during teardown.
